escalate.instructions: A line has decided it cannot go on alone. `nova-decide help --state` has already answered continue, ask-all-friends or ask-glenn from the line's own counters, and that answer is in the state as help_answer; this question is the second half -- to WHICH ROLE. The answer is a role and never a person. The human is reached only after the friends: an answer naming human while help_answer is ask-all-friends is overruled by the machinery, so do not spend the answer on it. criteria-escalate.md is the long form and is carried above.

criteria.security-designate: security_shaped_package is true, or what is stuck is a guard, a secret, the sandbox, sudo, deploy keys, the network, the reaper, the launcher or the merge machinery. Before any other answer.
criteria.design-authority: spec_is_silent_or_contradictory is true, or the stuck thing is a design default no ruling covers, kernel semantics, or scope.
criteria.lane-owner: Ordinary correctness, tests, or a document checked against what a binary prints, inside a lane that role owns.
criteria.all-friends: help_answer is ask-all-friends and no single role owns the question: it crosses lanes, or two rulings would have to agree.
criteria.coordinator: is_a_landing_order_question is true: sequencing, which branch goes first, whether to keep a card in flight.
criteria.human: ONLY where help_answer is ask-glenn -- the friends have been asked and it is still open -- and the question is one no role may rule: a rule of the fleet, a spend, a licence, or a contradiction between two of the person's own instructions.
